gen.title: Review of vocabulary for wing forces

cards.stem: Which symbol is used for density in the lift equation?
cards.quote: In the equation given above, the density is designated by the letter rho.
cards.hint: Recall the Greek letter used for density.

cards.stem: How is the lift coefficient generally found for most flow conditions?
cards.quote: But, in general, this parameter is determined experimentally.
cards.hint: Consider how most real flows are tested.

cards.stem: What single variable collects the complex effects of shape, inclination, viscosity and compressibility for lift?
cards.quote: For lift, this variable is called the lift coefficient, designated "Cl."
cards.hint: This variable gathers many complex effects into one.
